title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Korn Ferry Tour Expansion
items.text: The 2027 Korn Ferry Tour will award 40 PGA Tour cards across 25 tournaments in seven countries and 15 states, doubling the current allotment and raising stakes for rising pros.

items.headline: Senior PGA Pro Championship Site
items.text: Superstition Mountain Golf & Country Club in Arizona hosts the 2026 Senior PGA Professional Championship this week, featuring top senior PGA club professionals competing for senior major spots.

items.headline: Tiger Woods’ Post-Lesson Tip
items.text: Butch Harmon revealed Tiger Woods makes slow-motion swings after lessons to lock in changes, a technique amateurs should adopt to improve sequencing and contact.
